description: Add or remove Proton labels on many messages in one operation. Provide EITHER `uids` OR `match` (XOR), plus at least one of `labelsToAdd` / `labelsToRemove`. Same label-path rules as `update_message_labels` (must start with "Labels/"). Supports `dryRun: true` for safe preview.

dryRun.description: When true, preview the exact UIDs that would be updated without changing any labels.

folder.description: Source folder containing the messages (default: INBOX). Messages stay here; labels are additive.

labelsToAdd.description: Full label paths to add, each starting with `Labels/` (e.g. ["Labels/Work"]). Each label must already exist (create it with create_label). At least one of labelsToAdd/labelsToRemove must be non-empty.

labelsToRemove.description: Full label paths to remove (e.g. ["Labels/Work"]). Removing a label a message does not carry is a silent no-op.

match.description: Search criteria selecting the messages to label. Mutually exclusive with `uids`.

attachmentName.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on attachment filenames (e.g. "invoice", ".pdf"). Implies hasAttachment.

attachmentType.description: Case-insensitive MIME-type prefix filter on attachments (e.g. "application/pdf", "image/"). Implies hasAttachment.

uids.description: Explicit UIDs to label, scoped to `folder`. Mutually exclusive with `match` — provide exactly one.

name: bulk_update_labels
